title: Barrierefreiheit, Typsicherheit und Bedienbarkeit
description: As a developer, I want an accessible and strictly typed interface, so that the platform can be used by everyone and stays maintainable.

acceptance_criteria.when: a user navigates prompt list, detail view, editor and version history using the keyboard only
acceptance_criteria.then: every interactive element is reachable in a logical order and operable without a mouse
and: focus is visible at all times
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-035-accessibility-and-typing.feature: The interface is fully operable with the keyboard

acceptance_criteria.when: a screen reader user opens the prompt list and a flagged prompt
acceptance_criteria.then: the scan status is announced with its text label and not only by colour
and: form fields have associated labels and the status change is announced
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-035-accessibility-and-typing.feature: Screen readers announce the relevant elements

acceptance_criteria.given: a change with a type error is pushed
acceptance_criteria.then: the pipeline fails with the type error and the change cannot be merged
and: no implicit any, no unhandled promise and no unresolved lint warning is tolerated
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-035-accessibility-and-typing.feature: The build fails on type or lint errors

acceptance_criteria.when: a user reads the interface and an API client reads an error response
acceptance_criteria.then: the interface texts are German and the API error codes and field names are English
and: the language of the interface can be switched and the choice is remembered
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-035-accessibility-and-typing.feature: The interface is German while the API contract stays English
